title: Pan-Seared Tofu with Lemon Butter Sauce
description: A light and indulgent French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared tofu in a citrusy lemon butter sauce, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the tofu with salt and pepper.
Add 2 tablespoons of butter to the skillet and sear the tofu for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Pour in the lemon juice and stir to combine.
Return the tofu to the skillet and spoon some of the lemon butter sauce over the top.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
